regressions: Eleven actual Gradle Kotlin + stdlib scenarios use separate compile and runtime-only dependency JARs; safe templates, unreachable/folded readers and identity paths pass, while surviving reads, dynamic names, callbacks, initialization and unknown CharSequence paths fail.
Dependency methods participate in folded resource effects but do not become application entry points or source-comparison methods.

Inherited methods and exposed static fields preserve resource effects without invoking private constructors; an unused private-only type remains inactive. Application-only resources also activate this analysis without requiring external dependencies.

Independent declaration metadata checks omissions, field owners, inheritance, initialization and duplicate definitions. Exact Intrinsics contracts require unique byte identity; a replacement implementation retains its read.
Custom bundle providers, JPMS service factories, implicit manifest classpaths, semantic application annotations and unsupported layouts block incomplete scope.
Unknown or incomplete dispatch, bodies and initialization retain wildcard effects; no constant-pool absence or library namespace trust shortcut is used.
